name: Can I repair a damaged threshold myself, or should I hire a professional contractor?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair a damaged threshold myself, or should I hire a professional contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor cosmetic repairs like sealing small cracks might be manageable for a homeowner, more significant damage such as rot, structural issues, or full replacement is best handled by a professional contractor. Improper installation can lead to ongoing problems like water leaks, drafts, or operational issues with your door. A professional ensures proper material selection, correct installation techniques, and effective weatherproofing, guaranteeing a durable and effective repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor repairs might be DIY, but significant damage or full replacement requires a professional to ensure proper installation and durability.
